sources.description: We asked Chicago Bears fans earlier this week to grade Chicago’s entire offseason. From free agency to the draft, to training camp performances, to preseason, and everything in between. Nearly half of us gave it a B, but the prevailing thought in our comments was concern about the defensive line. There wasn’t a big free-agent […]
